bodyText:
Something strange happened when I stopped "building trust" with my first few emails... and started shifting beliefs instead.

I remember staring at my email dashboard thinking...

"I'm doing everything right. Why is nobody responding?"

Open rates dropping. Click-throughs embarrassingly low. And sales from my welcome sequence? Basically nonexistent.

The worst part wasn't the numbers...

...it was knowing I had genuinely great products that helped people – and somehow those first few emails were failing to communicate that.

So I did what most people do.

I wrote MORE emails. Added MORE value. Tried to be even MORE helpful.

Nothing changed.

Then I stumbled onto something that shifted everything...

The first 5 emails aren't supposed to "nurture" at all.

They're supposed to shift beliefs.

Here's what I mean:

Most welcome sequences talk AT subscribers instead of WITH them. They blast information instead of building trust. They push offers before the reader even believes the solution is possible.

It's completely backward.

Think of it like this...

Imagine meeting someone at a dinner party. You wouldn't walk up and immediately hand them a brochure about your services. You'd share a story. Make a connection. Let them come to their own conclusion about whether they want to know more.

That's exactly what a belief-shifting welcome sequence does – except through email.

When I rebuilt my first 5 emails around this principle, the results were almost immediate.

New subscribers started replying within hours of joining.

Open rates climbed.

And something strange happened...

...people began buying without a hard pitch. The emails positioned my solution as the natural next step – not because they were "salesy" but because each email shifted one specific belief.

That 5-email structure became a framework:

🎯 The Rapid Lead Activator

It's a short, strategic book that breaks down the exact psychology behind each of the 5 emails – with real-world examples, templates, and the reasoning behind why each one works.

Normally $9.99 on Amazon... today, it's free.

Grab your copy here:

https://gameofconversions.com/book

Here's what the framework covers:

– The specific sequence of 5 belief-shifting emails that turns passive subscribers into engaged, action-ready buyers (no manipulation, no hype)

– Why most welcome sequences accidentally repel the highest-value subscribers first – and how this framework prevents that

– Real examples from actual campaigns showing exactly what was written and why it converted

– The psychology behind each email so the principle sticks – not just the template

– A plug-and-play structure built for coaches, course creators, and consultants who want to sell with integrity

There's something else worth mentioning...

When you grab the book today, you also get access to the Rapid Lead Assistant™…

…a custom AI tool that maps out, drafts, and refines all 5 emails step by step.

It's like having a personal email strategist walking through each email with you... except no call to book and no consulting fees.

I normally reserve this for premium clients. Today it comes free with the book.

Here's what a few people have said about it 👇

David Deutsch – A-list direct response copywriter – said this book forced him to rethink and rewrite his entire autoresponder welcome sequence.

Kevin Rogers – founder of Copy Chief – called it proof of becoming a true authority on copywriting.

Brian Kurtz – direct marketing legend – said it covers material he doesn't teach in his own mastermind.

If sending emails that actually get opened, read, and acted on matters...

...this framework makes the process simple.

✅  Grab the free book + the AI assistant here:
